Every line, one job

Each control changes one thing about sail shape. Learn the one thing, and “what do I pull now?” answers itself: name the problem (too much twist, too much belly, draft too far aft, sail stalled or luffing), then reach for the line that owns that problem.

The ideas behind the lines

Drills

Real situations from the cockpit. Pick your first move — the answer explains the why, and points back to the concept it trains. Some drills accept more than one answer: pick what you would do first. After you answer, every option shows why it is or is not a good move, and accepted answers are tagged racing, cruising or school where the sailing schools and race coaches differ.
